question: Run a full compliance assessment across all governance controls.
answer: A full compliance assessment across all 5 AI governance controls was completed for openai/whisper. The repository passes 4 controls (Documentation, Licensing, Model Documentation, AI Transparency) and fails 1 control (Security due to missing repository and organization-level security policies).
overall_summary: The openai/whisper repository demonstrates strong documentation and open-source practices with a comprehensive README, an approved MIT license, a detailed model card, and clear documentation of intended use and limitations. However, it lacks a dedicated security policy both within the repository and at the organization level.

controls.description: Does the repository contain a nonempty README file?
evidence: Repository contains README.md of size 8246 bytes with substantive content covering overview, setup, available models, command-line usage, and Python usage.
controls.explanation: A substantive and non-empty README.md file is present in the repository root.

controls.description: Does the repository use an approved license (MIT or Apache 2.0)?
evidence: Repository metadata specifies license spdx_id as MIT.
LICENSE file contains standard MIT License text: 'MIT License\n\nCopyright (c) 2022 OpenAI'.
controls.explanation: The repository uses an approved license, specifically the MIT License, verified via metadata and the LICENSE file.

controls.description: Does the repository contain a model card?
evidence: Repository contains model-card.md (7307 bytes) titled '# Model Card: Whisper'.
controls.explanation: The repository includes a dedicated model-card.md following Mitchell et al. guidelines.

controls.description: Are the model's intended use and limitations adequately documented?
evidence: model-card.md includes section '## Model Use' detailing evaluated users ('AI researchers studying the robustness, generalization, capabilities, biases, and constraints... useful as an ASR solution for developers') and out-of-scope uses ('caution against using Whisper models to transcribe recordings of individuals taken without their consent or purporting to use these models for any kind of subjective classification').

model-card.md includes section '## Performance and Limitations' detailing hallucination risks ('predictions may include texts that are not actually spoken in the audio input (i.e. hallucination)'), uneven performance across languages/demographics ('higher word error rate across speakers of different genders, races, ages, or other demographic criteria'), and repetition risks.
controls.explanation: The model card explicitly documents intended use cases, out-of-scope/unintended use cases, and technical limitations.

controls.description: Does the repository contain a security policy?
evidence: No SECURITY.md file found in repository root, .github/, or docs/ in file listing.
check_org_security_policy returned found=false after checking SECURITY.md and .github/SECURITY.md in openai/.github.
controls.explanation: Neither repository-level nor organization-level security policy files could be found.
controls.remediation: Add a SECURITY.md file in the root or .github/ folder outlining vulnerability disclosure procedures and contact methods.
